hero_title: Hotels in Ho Chi Minh City
description: Discover the best hotels in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Landmark Five-Star Ho Chi Minh Escape in the Heart of Saigon with Rooftop Bar
hotels.description: Discover the beautiful French architecture and delicious street food of Ho Chi Minh City with a stay at the iconic Caravelle Saigon. Set in pulsing District 1 - also known as Downtown Saigon, an eclectic mix of old-world charm and fast-lane modernity - within walking distance of the city's most iconic sights, Caravelle Saigon offers world-class facilities and the finest comforts in one of the best locations in Ho Chi Minh City. Originally opened in 1959, this boutique hotel has been at the centre of some of the city's most significant cultural events. Whilst the original building has been lovingly refurbished, its striking French-Vietnamese style survived. Its gracefully curved balconies offer the grandest panoramas of Ho Chi Minh City, while the rooftop bar serves an unbeatable combination of expert cocktails and local brews.

hotels.vendor_name: Hotel Equatorial Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon)
hotels.title: Central Ho Chi Minh City Escape with Outdoor Pool, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: Stay close to Ho Chi Minh City’s most storied sights at this five-star base, perfectly placed where the city's energy converges. At Equatorial Ho Chi Minh City, you can stretch your itinerary further with a complimentary shuttle that connects you to the city’s major commercial and entertainment area in just eight minutes. Mornings can begin at the Equinox Fitness and Leisure Centre, where you’ll find a fully equipped fitness centre, step aerobics studio, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi and a dedicated spa and massage centre. When the afternoon heat settles in, cool off in the outdoor pool before lingering over cocktails at the poolside bar. Dining brings plenty of choice across five restaurants and bars, including a weekend seafood buffet and all-you-can-eat dim sum at Chit Chat at the Café.

hotels.title: Sophisticated Ho Chi Minh City Escape in Elegant Ba Son Neighbourhood with Rooftop Pool
hotels.description: Immerse yourself in the pulsating heart of Vietnam with a stay at Hotel Indigo Saigon The City, an IHG Hotel, perfectly positioned amid the city's bustling District 1. This vibrant escape is a stone's throw from the city's iconic landmarks, including the Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon and the Central Post Office. Savour authentic Vietnamese cuisine at the hotel's Neighbourhood Cafe, or sip on refreshing cocktails by the rooftop pool, boasting panoramic city views.

hotels.title: Award-Winning Ho Chi Minh City Escape with Club Lounge Access, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Discover a sanctuary of timeless hospitality and five-star elegance in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. New World Saigon Hotel is perfectly located in District 1, with Ben Thanh Market and the city's main cultural and dining districts on the doorstep. Your stay comes with full Residence Club Living Room access. Start each morning with breakfast in the lounge, graze on all-day refreshments, then wind down each evening with a light buffet dinner and drinks before heading out to explore. Five restaurants and bars cover everything from chef-led Italian at ParkView to Japanese at iBuki Restaurant, with the Whisper Bar & Lounge, Splash Pool Bar and Black Vinegar rounding out the options. The Coco Spa and outdoor pool offer a quieter counterpoint to the city outside.

hotels.title: Chic Ho Chi Minh City Apartment Escape near Crescent Mall & Convention Centre with Onsite Restaurant & Bar
hotels.description: Step into a world of refined Ho Chi Minh City living at this ideally positioned sanctuary in the dynamic District 7. Perfect for couples or groups, the hotel's studio and apartment-style accommodations make living easy in this prime location, near the SECC Saigon Exhibition and Convention Centre. Feast on authentic Vietnamese and Asian fusion at the all-day dining Food Exchange and sip on refreshing cocktails at its bar. If you wish to step out, glitzy Crescent Mall is moments away along with the picturesque waterfront promenade, lined with charming cafes and restaurants, offers serene vistas of the Saigon River.

hotels.title: French Colonial Grandeur in Ho Chi Minh City Centre with Award-Winning Dining & Spa
hotels.description: Set beside the Saigon Opera House in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, this stately hotel pairs French colonial elegance with contemporary sophistication. Inside, days unfold with pastries from The Pastry Boutique, French-Vietnamese at Square One or trattoria-style Italian at Opera, and wind down with cocktails at 2 Lam Son and melt-in-your-mouth treats at Chocolaterie. Settle into a sunlounger by the palm-lined outdoor pool or enjoy a deeply restorative treatment inspired by the botanicals of the Mekong Delta at Xuan Spa. Just beyond the hotel, Dong Khoi Street, the Notre Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office are within walking distance, making this the ideal refined base for discovery in Ho Chi Minh City.

hotels.vendor_name: Rêve Ho Chi Minh City, Vignette Collection by IHG
hotels.title: Ho Chi Minh City Elegance near Ben Thanh Market with Two Onsite Restaurants & Outdoor Pool
hotels.description: Step off Saigon’s busier boulevards and into a quieter chapter of the city, where heritage cafes and the old-world details of Antique Street set the tone for this five-star stay. At Rêve Ho Chi Minh City, Vignette Collection by IHG, you’re close to the Saigon Central Post Office and Ben Thanh Market, with some of Ho Chi Minh City’s best-loved landmarks within easy reach. Inside, days slow down around contemporary Indochine design, warm wood tones and a calm outdoor pool made for retreating between city wanders. Dining keeps you close to the city’s flavours, with Vietnamese flavours and a French bistro-inspired atmosphere at House of Kieu, plus afternoon tea or signature cocktails at Kieu Parlour.

hotels.title: Signature Luxury in Central Ho Chi Minh with Rooftop Pool, Spa & Onsite Dining
hotels.description: Experience Ho Chi Minh City with a stay a signature Sofitel stay, perfectly positioned in the heart of the city's bustling District 1. This French colonial-style hotel is a stone's throw from the city's most renowned landmarks, including the Saigon Notre-Dame Basilica and the War Remnants Museum. Savour the flavours of Vietnam at Le 17 Bistro, where you can enjoy local dishes with a French twist, or sip on expertly crafted cocktails at the chic Boudoir Lounge. For a change of pace, take a leisurely stroll along the Saigon River, just minutes from the hotel. After a day of exploration, retreat to the hotel's rooftop pool for a refreshing dip, or rejuvenate your senses at BREMIERE Spa.

hotels.title: Ho Chi Minh City French-Inspired Elegance with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Cocktails & One-time Dinner
hotels.description: Indulge in world-class service and French-inspired luxury at this five-star Sofitel haven. Situated on Saigon's tree-lined Le Duan Boulevard in District 1 - just minutes from iconic landmarks like Saigon Notre Dame Cathedral, Independence Palace and the Botanical Garden - the hotel places you right in the heart of Vietnam's largest city. From the moment you enter the grand marble lobby, you’re welcomed into a world of refined elegance. The hotel’s exceptional dining venues offer something for every taste, including an open kitchen serving up Asian and French masterpieces at Mezz, or French delicacies paired with chic interiors at Le 17 Bistro. Drink in breathtaking views of the city skyline from the rooftop pool, sip expertly crafted cocktails at the extravagant Ministry concept bar, or unwind at Bremiere Wellness Centre with a treatment for the senses. Stay active with complimentary yoga classes, and relax in the sauna and steam room - every detail is taken care of.
